description: This file defines an interface class IActiveRequests for managing active media requests within the Rialto server component. It declares methods for inserting, retrieving, erasing, and managing media request segments, serving as a contract for implementing classes.

classes.name: IActiveRequests
classes.description: An interface class for managing active media requests, including methods for insertion, retrieval, deletion, and segment management.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new media request with specified media source type and maximum media bytes.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the media source type associated with a given request ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a media request by request ID or media source type.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to a specific request identified by request ID.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Retrieves the list of media segments associated with a specific request ID.
